description: This file defines the enumeration ConditionType, which represents different condition types used within the Fineract project. It includes constants such as INVALID, LESSTHAN, EQUAL, GRETERTHAN, and NOT_EQUAL, along with utility methods for conversion and property access.

classes.name: ConditionType
classes.description: An enum representing various condition types with associated integer values and codes. Provides methods for conversion from integers, retrieving properties, and utility checks.

methods.name: fromInt
methods.description: Converts an integer to the corresponding ConditionType enum value, returning INVALID if the input is null or does not match a known value.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Overrides default toString to return the enum name with underscores replaced by spaces.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Returns the integer value associated with the ConditionType.

methods.name: getCode
methods.description: Returns the string code associated with the ConditionType.

methods.name: isInvalid
methods.description: Checks whether the current ConditionType instance represents an invalid condition.

methods.name: integerValues
methods.description: Returns an array of integer values for all valid ConditionType enums, excluding INVALID.
